name: Naomi
source:
The fiery leader of the evil twins, Naomi always gets what she wants. And what she wants is the hottest girl in school.

Always scheeming with her twin sister [url=/c106072]Mia[/url], Naomi is never too far from trouble - and that always means trouble for someone else.

No one is safe from her corrupting beauty - not even her long-suffering mother, [url=/c106074]Abigail[/url].

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Naomi]DumbKoala[/url]]
